#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Independent original-package audit, without installing or executing packages."""
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import datetime, hashlib, json, re, subprocess, tarfile, zipfile

ROOT=Path('/workspace/scratch/28ff48ed8b8b/LINUX-LOGIC-PRO')
BASE=Path('/workspace/scratch/28ff48ed8b8b/w5_artifact_review')
DOWNLOAD=Path('/workspace/scratch/28ff48ed8b8b/darling-A1-debs')
A1='44e8c15342f27bb2ac1d56bbac0f146b7276338f'
A4='4a3695922f33e72a91cf66d618e64187575da8e1'
API=json.loads((BASE/'darling-A1-authenticated-api.json').read_text())
run=API['run']
assert (run['id'],run['path'],run['event'],run['head_branch'],run['head_sha'],run['status'],run['conclusion'])==(42332874605,'.github/workflows/actions.yaml','push','main',A1,'completed','success')
assert run['repository']['full_name']==run['head_repository']['full_name']=='boop-bip80/LINUX-LOGIC-PRO'
jobs=API['jobs']['jobs']
assert {j['name'] for j in jobs}=={'build-deb','build-dsc','create-source-artifact'}
assert all(j['status']=='completed' and j['conclusion']=='success' for j in jobs)
metadata=next(a for a in API['artifacts']['artifacts'] if a['id']==13560011523)
assert metadata['name']=='debs' and metadata['expired'] is False
assert metadata['workflow_run']['id']==run['id'] and metadata['workflow_run']['head_sha']==A1

def digest_file(path):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open('rb') as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda:stream.read(1024*1024),b''): h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()

archive=DOWNLOAD/'original.zip'
assert archive.stat().st_size==metadata['size_in_bytes']==117550146
assert 'sha256:'+digest_file(archive)==metadata['digest']=='sha256:4e876e6005512e1ec29fd684c00ba3a469bfb6f00d55b65ef6f52615baab1db2'
control=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',A1+':debian/control'],cwd=ROOT,text=True)
expected_packages=set(re.findall(r'^Package: (\S+)$',control,re.M))
production_diff=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only',A1,A4,'--','debian','tools/debian'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip()
assert not production_diff
magic_pin=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-tree',A4,'src/external/file'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip()
assert 'c6ee65265d253d24b1a496f8ca54b5e449fe108c' in magic_pin
packages=[]; inventory=[]; seen_names=set(); magic=None
with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as z:
    members=z.infolist()
    assert len(members)==len(expected_packages)==22
    for info in members:
        name=info.filename
        assert name not in seen_names and not info.is_dir()
        assert PurePosixPath(name).name==name and name.endswith('.deb')
        assert ((info.external_attr>>16)&0o170000) in (0,0o100000)
        seen_names.add(name)
        h=hashlib.sha256(); size=0
        with z.open(info) as stream:
            for chunk in iter(lambda:stream.read(1024*1024),b''):
                h.update(chunk);size+=len(chunk)
        assert size==info.file_size
        deb=DOWNLOAD/'files'/name
        assert deb.stat().st_size==size and digest_file(deb)==h.hexdigest()
        fields=subprocess.check_output(['dpkg-deb','--field',str(deb),'Package','Version','Architecture'],text=True)
        fields=dict(line.split(': ',1) for line in fields.strip().splitlines())
        assert fields['Package'] in expected_packages
        assert fields['Version']=='0.1.20261107-1~resolute'
        assert fields['Architecture']=='amd64'
        assert name==f"{fields['Package']}_{fields['Version']}_{fields['Architecture']}.deb"
        process=subprocess.Popen(['dpkg-deb','--fsys-tarfile',str(deb)],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        package_inventory=[];paths=set();regular_bytes=0
        try:
            with tarfile.open(fileobj=process.stdout,mode='r|') as data:
                for member in data:
                    normalized=member.name[2:] if member.name.startswith('./') else member.name
                    if normalized=='.': normalized=''
                    assert not normalized.startswith('/') and '..' not in PurePosixPath(normalized).parts
                    assert normalized not in paths
                    paths.add(normalized)
                    item={'path':normalized,'size_bytes':member.size,'mode':member.mode,'uid':member.uid,'gid':member.gid}
                    if member.isfile():
                        item['type']='file'; payload=data.extractfile(member); ph=hashlib.sha256(); count=0; payload_bytes=[]
                        wanted=(fields['Package']=='darling-cli' and normalized=='usr/libexec/darling/usr/share/file/magic/elf')
                        for chunk in iter(lambda:payload.read(1024*1024),b''):
                            ph.update(chunk);count+=len(chunk)
                            if wanted:payload_bytes.append(chunk)
                        assert count==member.size
                        item['sha256']=ph.hexdigest();regular_bytes+=count
                        if wanted:magic={'bytes':b''.join(payload_bytes),'metadata':dict(item)}
                    elif member.isdir():item['type']='directory'
                    elif member.issym():item.update(type='symlink',target=member.linkname)
                    elif member.islnk():item.update(type='hardlink',target=member.linkname)
                    else:raise AssertionError('Unexpected special package payload: '+member.name)
                    package_inventory.append(item)
            process.stdout.close()
            error=process.stderr.read().decode('utf-8','replace')
            assert process.wait(timeout=60)==0,error
        finally:
            if process.poll() is None:process.kill();process.wait()
        encoded=json.dumps(package_inventory,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()
        packages.append({'filename':name,'package':fields['Package'],'version':fields['Version'],'architecture':fields['Architecture'],'size_bytes':size,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'zip_crc32':info.CRC,'payload_entries':len(package_inventory),'regular_payload_bytes':regular_bytes,'payload_inventory_sha256':hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()})
        inventory.append({'package':fields['Package'],'entries':package_inventory})
assert {p['package'] for p in packages}==expected_packages
assert magic is not None
assert len(magic['bytes'])==11148
assert hashlib.sha256(magic['bytes']).hexdigest()=='ee93154f71cf3b9e1ce8f105d8ef8b9f5b04653502d867fd3a3d1cf310a9860d'
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','hash-object','--stdin'],input=magic['bytes'],cwd=ROOT).decode().strip()=='f5e1af9a25bc47f43016763c6d739f67b0d5c164'
inventory_path=BASE/'darling-A1-package-payload-inventory.json'
inventory_path.write_text(json.dumps(inventory,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n')
record={'schema':'darling.independent-packaging-closure.v1','reviewer':'/root/w3_packaging_transport_review','reviewed_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'verdict':'PASS','phase_acceptance':'NOT_EVALUATED','scope':'Authenticated original successful native Debian packaging at A1, production packaging files unchanged through A4','tested_source_commit':A1,'final_candidate_commit':A4,'production_packaging_diff':production_diff,'workflow_run_id':run['id'],'jobs':[{'id':j['id'],'name':j['name'],'status':j['status'],'conclusion':j['conclusion']} for j in jobs],'original_artifact':metadata,'archive_validation':{'size_bytes':archive.stat().st_size,'sha256':digest_file(archive),'zip_crc_and_every_member':'PASS','member_count':len(packages),'members_match_saved_original_package_bytes':True},'packages':packages,'package_count':len(packages),'all_declared_packages_present':True,'full_payload_inventory':{'file':inventory_path.name,'sha256':digest_file(inventory_path),'size_bytes':inventory_path.stat().st_size,'entries':sum(p['payload_entries'] for p in packages),'regular_bytes':sum(p['regular_payload_bytes'] for p in packages)},'magic_rule_preservation':{'package':'darling-cli','source_repository':'darlinghq/darling-file','source_commit':'c6ee65265d253d24b1a496f8ca54b5e449fe108c','source_path':'file/magic/Magdir/elf','source_git_blob':'f5e1af9a25bc47f43016763c6d739f67b0d5c164',**magic['metadata'],'exact_pinned_source_bytes':True},'limitations':['No package installed or executed; package controls and complete data tar streams were independently parsed and all regular payload bytes hashed.','Full source/source-package ZIPs exceed the connector download limit and were not inspected by this reviewer. Their original metadata and successful hosted source jobs are authenticated.','A1 successful native packaging is closure evidence for the original failures, not a substitute for final exact-source P004 artifact acceptance.']}
output=BASE/'darling-A1-packaging-closure.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'verdict':record['verdict'],'packages':len(packages),'payload_entries':record['full_payload_inventory']['entries'],'regular_bytes':record['full_payload_inventory']['regular_bytes'],'magic_unchanged':True,'report':str(output)},indent=2))
